نتتابع (form VI)
# نَتَتَابَعُ (natatābaʕu) /na.ta.taː.ba.ʕu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَتَابَعَ (tatābaʕa)
# نَتَتَابَعَ (natatābaʕa) /na.ta.taː.ba.ʕa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَتَابَعَ (tatābaʕa)
# نَتَتَابَعْ (natatābaʕ) /na.ta.taː.baʕ/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَتَابَعَ (tatābaʕa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
